def walk(node, parent_body=None):
    if node.tag == "body":

    for child in node:
        if child.tag == "joint":
            name = child.get("name")
            axis = child.get("axis", "0 0 1")
            rng  = child.get("range", "0 0").split()
            lo, hi = float(rng[0]), float(rng[1])
            joints[name] = {"axis": axis, "range": [lo, hi], "parent_body": parent_body}
        walk(child, parent_body)
